args.sql:
SELECT 
    rm.riskandmarginpivot AS "Risk/Margin Record ID", 
    (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum')::DECIMAL(12,3) AS "Position Value", 
    (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn')::TEXT AS "Position Leverage Multiplier", 
    ab.walletsum AS "Account Balance", 
    (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum')::DECIMAL(12,3) / ab.walletsum AS "Leverage Ratio" 
FROM 
    riskandmargin rm 
JOIN 
    accountbalances ab ON rm.ordervault = ab.usertag;

SELECT 
    rm.riskandmarginpivot AS "Risk/Margin Record ID", 
    (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum')::DECIMAL(12,3) AS "Position Value", 
    (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn')::TEXT AS "Position Leverage Multiplier", 
    ab.walletsum AS "Account Balance", 
    (rm.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum')::DECIMAL(12,3) / ab.walletsum AS "Leverage Ratio" 
FROM 
    riskandmargin rm 
JOIN 
    orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault 
JOIN 
    accountbalances ab ON o.userlink = ab.usertag;
